description: A GenServer call under a region that allows one obligation (set at 0; t.0 starts at 100, after it): the call's reply permit obligation is refused by max_obligations, so the reply permit is untracked, and the server's reply is still delivered (regression of 819502b, fuzz cases gen-1101-66 and gen-1208-192). C refused to send on the untracked reply permit (its obligation id no longer named an obligation), traced gen_server::reply_caller_gone and left the caller waiting for good.
